request.cursor: null or the previous response cursor

response.cancelTasks: task IDs observed during this wait, or null when a gap requires rechecking all active claims

semantics.authority: Authenticated transport control; hints confer no execution, ownership or cancellation authority.
semantics.commit: Queue index and cancellation mutations publish after commit, before delivery acknowledgement; rollback may cause a harmless invalidation but never an execution.
semantics.subscribe: Read an initial cursor before the first queue probe. Compare the next cursor before waiting, so a commit between probe and wait cannot be lost.
semantics.idle: A wait consumes no semantic transaction, command receipt or queue query. Its existing request deadline bounds the connection; an unchanged response does not trigger a probe.
semantics.reconnect: A new authority epoch or lost response invalidates the queue and active claim observations.
semantics.retention: Only generations and currently waiting connections are retained. No notification log or durable user data is created.
semantics.shutdown: Authority shutdown wakes every waiting connection before joining transport workers. A client joins its watch by interrupting only the socket exclusively borrowed by that request; a cancelled pooled session is retired before reuse.

declarations: intptr_t tofudb_embed_watch_execute(void*, const uint8_t*, size_t, uint8_t*, size_t);
embeddedAbi.lifetime: The runtime retains admitted calls. Each watch token owns its authority condition and cancellation flag. Cancel may precede enrollment or race execute; free follows joined execute and detached cancellation borrowers. Runtime close cancels all tokens before joining calls. A token grants no semantic execution authority.
embeddedAbi.replay: Response buffer growth may repeat only the read watch; an intervening commit returns a gap and invalidates observations. No command receipt or durable mutation occurs.
